digest.component_or_area: Mutation testing gate and CI workflow
propositions: Historical mutant count ceilings in signing.py are stale (814 mutants vs 491 recorded); enforcing old limits blocks unrelated work while accepting all survivors would normalize contract gaps.

Mutation enforcement must progress through three phased modes (advisory, ratchet, strict) with evidence-driven promotion, explicit per-shard timeout bindings from a manifest, and zero cached mutation verdicts across runs.

Selection must map changed source, test, support, and global inputs to affected behavioral shards; detect renames/deletions; report unmatched tests; preserve empty selections; and fail on unresolved refs.

Each shard runs in an isolated 30-minute job with fresh base/head archives, pinned mutmut 3.7.0, --max-children 1, and structured evidence output; ratchet blocks killed mutants that become survived or timeout, strict requires all mutants killed or individually fingerprinted.
Documentation and contract tests must assert phased policy, promotion evidence, manifest authority, CI cadence, and absence of legacy score tables.
